I'll look at your current program and what you've got set up so I can build the right way around 12-hour shifts. Looks like you're starting fresh. That 12-hour shift work is real — recovery and energy matter more than usual, especially on your feet that long.

To build this right, I need a few things: What's your experience level with lifting (beginner, intermediate, advanced)? What's your main goal — strength, muscle, endurance, or just staying healthy around the shifts? And do you have a home gym or access to a full gym? Once I know that, I'll build a program that fits the schedule you actually live with, not one that assumes you've got all day to train.
